execution: decision at close(D) from signals through 20:00 UTC of D; returns close(D)->close(D+1). No look-ahead.
note: walk-forward, point-in-time signals; vol-managed variant rescales 20d realized vol to the 20% target (capped at 1.5x gross).
interpretation: CORRECTED walk-forward (352 trading days, 2021-08 to 2022-12 bear market): execution timing fixed to close(D) entry from signals through 20:00 UTC of D - an earlier version had look-ahead bias (day-D news earning part of day-D's move) and reported +4.8pts. The corrected strategy beats its cap-weight benchmark by +0.9pt net of costs. Findings: (1) the 20%-vol-targeted variant cut the loss to -10.5% with realized vol 20.7% vs target 20% - vol management is the standout result (Moreira-Muir 2017); (2) attribution: per-entity-driven tilts added +148bps on NVDA, +131bps on AAPL, +85bps on META, and cost -150bps on MSFT; (3) equal-weight beat both (small-cap skew in 2022); (4) turnover averaged 5.5%/day - the binding constraint, regime-dependent.
